text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae's challenge in the Twinkle 
Series. Those dazzling three years had 
come to an end—

Carried alongside nostalgia, the vivid 
brilliance of that star entered people's 
hearts... no doubt reminding each of them 
of their own warm memories.

...Yet she continues to shine without end. 
Spreading her wings with pride in her 
brilliance, to deliver her feelings to an 
even wider world—
(WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
“—Now then, let's hear some comments from 
Hokko Tarumae, who claimed a spectacular 
victory in the Kawasaki Kinen!”

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for your support! Today, 
I'd like to take this opportunity to make 
a declaration to everyone!
(Murmur, murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...I, Hokko Tarumae, have officially 
accepted the invitation from Dubai from 
the other day, and—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to challenge Dubai's 
international GⅠ!!
(Ooooohhhhhh!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer!

I handed Hokko Tarumae the "Tarumae Cheer 
Banner" from Tomakomai, which had been 
brought all the way from her hometown just 
for this day...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahh!!!

Hokko Tarumae raises her cheer flag high 
and begins to run—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I will! As the star born in Tomakomai!! 
As the star of the dirt that everyone 
raised!! Deliver my shine to the world!!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Please!! Please, pretty please!! Cheer on 
my challengeーーーーーー!!!!"
(WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

And so, Hokko Tarumae's challenge in Dubai 
was officially announced—

"...It happened one day, shortly before 
our departure for Dubai."

"Back in her hometown of Tomakomai, a 
send-off party was being held for Hokko 
Tarumae—"

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Citizen
text_block_list.text:
“—Tarumae-chan! Make sure you don't get 
sick over there, okay!? Ahh, now I'm 
starting to worry...!”

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't worry about it at all! My 
friends prepared a whole bunch of 
anti-stress goodies for me, so I'll be 
totally fine overseas♪

text_block_list.name: Haskap Farm Owner
text_block_list.text:
Don't overdo it, okay? Just make sure you 
come back safe and sound.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll definitely come back. Look 
forward to your souvenirs, okay?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tarumae~!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Authentic surf clam curry really is on 
another level! It's so delicious~!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...You do realize this is supposed to be 
my send-off party, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Because my lucky item was curry! ...Well, 
that's half a joke, though—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
So you're not denying the 'half serious' 
part...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—An overseas expedition to Dubai. It's 
going to be brutal.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "Even so, Tarumae, are you really going?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I told you, I don't believe in feng shui. 
Still, I'll keep it in mind.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Even Falco-san had a tough time... There's 
no way I wouldn't be careful.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! Just showing you care makes a 
world of difference! So don't forget that 
first. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae's path isn't strictly hardship and 
nothing else. Because there is definitely 
a guiding light to overcome difficulties.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...I already know that better than anyone!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Hey, Rickey. Promise me.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
While I'm away, I'm leaving the domestic 
dirt scene in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You'd better hype it up for real. More 
than ever before! Enough to—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Enough to rewrite the record I set!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Aha☆ Even if you hadn't told me, that was 
the plan all along! Even so—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'd like you to make a promise to me too, 
Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—Come back, without fail, and run with me 
again.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We are bound by the principle of mutual 
generation, stronger than anything else. 
Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I don't even want to imagine the Twinkle 
Series without Tarumae!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'll be waiting. At the pinnacle of dirt, 
for you, Tarumae!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, got it.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
We'll definitely run together again. 
...Promise.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Promise!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, youth. It sure is nice being young.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, well. Falco-san, you're talking just 
like an old grandma.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: You're the one saying that, Acute-san?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Still, seriously—youth really is dazzling, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Let's live our youth to the fullest again 
and again, Falco-san.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I'll always be here. ...Right on the 
front lines of the dirt tracks, your home 
turf."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Acute-san—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Yep☆

"...Time marches on. Bearing both that 
which changes and that which does not 
equally, it flows endlessly onward——"

And then, the day of Hokko Tarumae's 
departure abroad arrived—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I'll be far away from Tomakomai 
and the Academy, so... just a little 
bit...—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...I believe what Rickey says is right.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"This challenge in Dubai... It's surely 
going to be incredibly, intensely tough."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder why. It's strange, but deep 
down inside, something's screaming at me 
that this is bad news—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
This is the first time I've ever felt this 
way... No matter what I do, I just can't 
shake off this feeling...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Even so, I don't feel like stopping them.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If it doesn't work out this time, there's 
a second try. If the second doesn't work, 
third time's the charm.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
There's definitely a part of me that wants 
to keep going and take on the challenge 
like that.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Even if it takes a fourth time, or even 
more than that.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Because I have—a "hometown."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No matter what hardships I face, I have my 
"hometown" giving me courage and urging me 
forward.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, don't you know?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Nobody ever said you can only have one 
"hometown."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"The 'hometown' where I was born and 
raised is indeed Tomakomai. However—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"The reason I've been able to give it my 
all up until today is because my precious, 
beloved 'hometown'—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's all because you were right there 
beside me, Trainer, you know?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: That's why...—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Please continue to watch over me from by 
my side.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...And then, one day. I'll become 
Trainer's—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking... it would be nice if I 
could become one of your "hometowns"—
choice_data_list: I've been doing that for a long time.

text_block_list.text:
Everything I've received from Hokko 
Tarumae so far. Everything I want to give 
to her from now on. I can feel both 
distinctly right now.

That warmth... gives me the strength to 
face whatever future awaits without fear.
choice_data_list:
—So let's keep taking on challenges 
together, the two of us.

text_block_list.text:
—Toward a future unknown to anyone. The 
migratory bird with paper wings takes 
flight.
